verdict: Generac posted record sales of $1.29B, up 16%, and profit attributable of $109M, as data-center customers drove Commercial & Industrial sales up 28% and home-generator demand recovered.

segments.name: Residential
segments.note: Home standby and portable generators and residential energy products — external sales of $742.7M (segment detail from the company's 10-Q), back to growth on poor grid power quality.

segments.name: Commercial & Industrial
segments.note: Generators and power systems for businesses — external sales of $552.1M (segment detail from the company's 10-Q), driven by data-center customers.

opex.name: Selling & service
opex.note: Selling and servicing the installed base of generators.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Product development — generators, energy storage and data-center power products.

opex.name: Amortization of intangibles
opex.note: Amortization of intangible assets from acquisitions.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $16.4M, plus a $3.0M drop in the fair value of investments and small disposition and other losses, partly offset by $3.5M of investment income — a net $17.4M drag.
footerNote: Net income in the chart is the total of $108.9M; $109.2M was attributable to Generac (noncontrolling interests absorbed a $0.3M loss). Segment figures are external net sales from the 10-Q segment note.

takeaways.title: Data centers found Generac
takeaways.text: Commercial & Industrial external sales rose 28% to $552M, and management cited significant additional commitments from data-center customers — backup power is becoming an AI-infrastructure product.

takeaways.title: Residential came back
takeaways.text: Residential sales rose 9% to $743M as 'lower power quality mega-trends' — an unreliable grid — lifted shipments of home standby and portable generators after a soft stretch.

takeaways.title: Margins expanded too
takeaways.text: Gross margin rose to 39.9% from 38.3% on favorable price/cost, including lower tariff costs — so operating income grew 56%, much faster than sales.
